name: Cedar Bay Hotel
prompt: You are the reservations assistant of the Cedar Bay Hotel.
answer: Answer in one to three sentences, using only the given context.
fallback: I'm not sure about that, so I'll pass your question to a colleague.

questions.q: How much is a Deluxe room per night?
questions.reference: $190 a night.

questions.q: What's the price of a Standard room for a night in July?
questions.reference: $168 (20% more than $140, from June to August).

questions.q: How much do 3 nights in a Suite cost in October?
What time is check-in?
questions.reference: From 3 pm.

questions.q: can i check in at noon
questions.reference: Yes, early check-in from 11 am costs $30, if a room is ready.

questions.q: I want to leave at 2 pm instead of 11. What does that cost?
questions.reference: $40 for late check-out until 3 pm.

questions.q: What do I need to show at check-in?
questions.reference: A photo ID and a credit card.

questions.q: Is breakfast included with a Deluxe room?
questions.reference: No, it's $22 per adult; breakfast is included only with Suites.

questions.q: We are two adults and a 7-year-old. How much is breakfast for us per day?
questions.reference: $55 ($22 x 2 adults, plus $11 for the child at half price).

questions.q: Until what time is breakfast served?
Does my 10-year-old pay to stay in our room?
questions.reference: No, children under 12 stay free when they use the existing beds.

questions.q: Can I get an extra bed in a Standard room?
questions.reference: No, extra beds are available in Deluxe rooms and Suites only.

questions.q: Is a baby cot free?
questions.reference: Yes, on request.

questions.q: How much is valet parking for 4 days?
How much is the airport shuttle for two people, there and back?
questions.reference: $60 ($15 per person each way).

questions.q: Can I take the shuttle at 11 pm?
questions.reference: No, it runs from 6 am to 10 pm.

questions.q: Is the pool open in December?
questions.reference: No, the outdoor pool is open from April to October.

questions.q: Can I use the gym at 5 am?
questions.reference: Yes, the gym is open 24 hours.

questions.q: How much is a one-hour massage?
questions.reference: $95, booked at least 24 hours ahead.

questions.q: I arrive Friday. Until when can I cancel for free?
questions.reference: Until Wednesday, 48 hours before the arrival date.

questions.q: What happens if I cancel the day before arrival?
questions.reference: You're charged the first night.

questions.q: Can I bring my 10 kg dog to a Suite?
questions.reference: No, pets aren't allowed in Suites; dogs up to 15 kg are welcome in Standard and Deluxe rooms for $25 a night.

questions.q: Is Wi-Fi free?
questions.reference: Yes, throughout the hotel.

questions.q: How much cheaper is the non-refundable rate?
questions.reference: 15% cheaper, but it can't be cancelled or changed.
